Shared rules for the careful day
This section explains the plain rules

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: This section sets the daily rules for careful, fair, and humane handling of companion animal travel requests at Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk serves customers with calm attention and clear guidance. The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions, and staff support each traveler with patience and respect. Every animal receives steady care from trained staff, and all service changes are entered in the desk ledger so the record remains clear and complete. When a customer arrives with a pet, staff should confirm the travel plan, review carrier readiness, and speak in a reassuring manner that helps the customer understand what will happen next. <<FACT F064>> The team should never promise acceptance before the required checks are complete, and it should never suggest that a rule may be set aside for convenience.

If a pet appears distressed, staff should pause the process and seek the senior coordinator's direction before continuing. Customers should be told plainly if a carrier, handling method, or travel condition is not suitable for safe transport. Where service can continue, staff should explain the next step in simple terms and keep the customer informed without delay. If a change is made to an approved booking, the ledger must show the reason for the change and the staff member responsible for the update. Care, dignity, and consistency remain the guiding standards for every case.

Any uncertainty, exception request, or welfare concern must be referred to the senior coordinator or the duty lead at once so the customer receives clear and proper support.
